subject: Re: EvaNet kickoff: evolved video architectures for activity recognition
body:
Lucia,

Staffing plan against the milestones.

Yusuf 70% on ensemble reproduction and eval methodology, Giannis 60% on serving, Halima 40% on partner-data ingestion. On the hard part you flagged: Rafael Duran is committed at 60% for May 2026 to own the optical-flow pipeline and the ensemble-evaluation work - that allocation is in the sheet and it's what makes the June milestone possible. Flow computation at partner-archive scale is the schedule driver, so his May is the whole ballgame.

Compute: inference reproduction is cheap (checkpoints run on a handful of Titan A100s). The June partner-data evaluation is bigger - flow precompute across ~40k archive videos - but still batch-friendly on Titan best-effort. No reservations requested.

One watch item: checkpoint download and the label_map/data assets moved when we mirrored the release internally; Giannis is checksumming everything so we don't silently eval with mismatched weights.

Deshawn
